ideas.description: On the E026 tip (commit da18628: compiled batched Muon, 2@16 + 2@24 + 4@32 px, 8.0 epochs), change only the schedule to 3@16 + 1@24 + 4@32 px, so epoch 2 moves from 24 px to 16 px. Keep the same operator (flip + translate-2 at 32 px, then antialiased bilinear downsample), AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1), and Muon/SGD hyperparameters. The step count is unchanged, so the LR/EMA/lookahead schedules are unchanged too. All shapes are already warmed up in build.
ideas.expected: Time about 5.28-5.35 s, -3 to -4% vs 5.501 s: one epoch drops from ~0.485 s to ~0.27 s. Accuracy 0.753-0.757, i.e. -0.0 to -0.3 pp; E026 cost ~0.15 pp per 24->16 epoch swap. If it is >=0.753, it is the new tip and shows the early phase tolerates 16 px across 3/8 of training. A loss of >=0.4 pp means the 24 px bridge epoch is what carries the transfer to 32 px, and the next cut should look elsewhere.

ideas.description: On the E026 tip, change only the Muon momentum from 0.6 to 0.5 (Nesterov kept, lr 0.24, compiled update unchanged; pass momentum so nothing recompiles, or rewarm in build). E027 showed 0.85 costs 1.18 pp. This tests the other direction, since the lookahead-EMA and Nesterov already smooth the iterates and the 0.6 value was tuned on CIFAR-10 at bs 2000 without lookahead.
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (±0.5%, ~5.50 s). Accuracy -0.3 to +0.4 pp vs 0.7565. A gain of >=0.3 pp buys ~0.5 epoch-equivalents at zero cost and becomes the tip (more margin for schedule cuts). A loss of >=0.3 pp brackets 0.6 as near-optimal, and momentum tuning is closed.

ideas.description: On the E026 tip, change only the number of Newton-Schulz iterations in the compiled batched Muon update, from 3 to 2 (same quintic coefficients, bf16). Re-warm the compiled update in build for every filter shape. Everything else is identical. The remaining Muon overhead is ~1 ms/step x 384 steps (~0.4 s, ~7% of the run), and the NS matmuls are most of it; per the E019 micro-benchmark, eager GPU time fell 3.8 -> 2.8 ms with 2 steps.
ideas.expected: Time -1.5 to -3% (about 5.35-5.42 s). Accuracy -0.3 to +0.1 pp (a less orthogonalized update). If accuracy holds >=0.753 with time -1.5% or better, it is the new tip. If time falls by <1%, the residual Muon cost is in momentum/cast/update traffic rather than NS, and the remaining lever is bs 2000 for Muon.

ideas.description: Margin check on the current tip (E026, replacing the stale I032, which targeted E021), with no recipe change. In an untimed side script, import the arena submission and run it through the benchmark's own trial code (do not edit benchmark/) on extra seeds 3-10. Record per-seed accuracy and time. For the scored row, repeat E026 unchanged. This calibrates how much of the 0.35 pp margin on seeds 0-2 is real before more is spent on cuts.
ideas.expected: Accuracy and time of the scored run identical to E026 (0.7565, ~5.50 s). Mean over seeds 3-10 is 0.752-0.757, std ~0.3-0.4 pp. If it is >=0.754, later cut rounds may spend down to ~0.753 on seeds 0-2. If it is <0.752, seeds 0-2 are a favourable draw, and future tips need a 3-seed mean >=0.756.

ideas.description: Explore the limit of the very-low-res early phase. On the E026 tip, change only the schedule to 4@16 + 4@32 px (8.0 epochs, no 24 px phase). Same operator, same Muon/SGD hyperparameters, same step count and schedules. 16 px and 32 px shapes are already warmed up in build. This is the aggressive end of the line, beyond the 3@16 + 1@24 variant, and tests whether a 24 px bridge is needed at all.
ideas.expected: Time about 5.05-5.15 s (-6.5 to -8% vs 5.501 s). Accuracy 0.749-0.755 (-0.1 to -0.7 pp). If it is >=0.753, it is the new tip at the best exchange rate yet. If the loss is >=0.5 pp while 3@16 + 1@24 holds, the last pre-tail epoch needs >=24 px.

ideas.description: On the E026 tip, change only the Muon learning rate from 0.24 to 0.18 (the shape of the schedule is unchanged; the LR is passed as the existing 0-d GPU tensor, so nothing recompiles). E027 suggested that larger effective Muon steps overshoot in this short, lookahead-averaged schedule. This tests whether a smaller step size helps at bs 1024 (0.24 was tuned at bs 2000 on CIFAR-10).
ideas.expected: Time unchanged (±0.5%). Accuracy -0.4 to +0.4 pp vs 0.7565. A gain of >=0.3 pp gives free margin to spend on the schedule cuts. A loss of >=0.3 pp suggests 0.24 is at or below the optimum, so a follow-up at 0.30 is warranted.

ideas.description: Observational, on the E026 tip with no recipe change (replacing the stale I033, which assumed eager Muon on E021). During one scored run, sample board power and SM clock via NVML at >=10 Hz in a separate monitoring process launched outside the submission (no sleeps in submission code). Tag samples by phase (16 px, 24 px, 32 px) using logged CUDA-event timestamps. Report, per phase, the fraction of time at >=95% of the 400 W cap and the mean SM clock.
ideas.expected: Accuracy and time identical to E026 (±0.5%). The 32 px phase sits at the cap for >=80% of its time. The 16 px phase sits below 90% of the cap for >=30% of its time (small maps, per-step Muon and launch costs dominate). If so, the early phase is overhead-bound, and per-step fixes (bs 2000 in the 16 px phase only, fewer NS steps) pay off there specifically.

drop.reason: Stale base: it measures margin on E021, which E024 and E026 have superseded. Re-proposed as an extra-seeds margin check on the E026 tip.
Stale base: it assumes eager Muon on E021. Compiled Muon (E024) and the 16 px phase (E026) change what each phase is bound by. Re-proposed as per-phase power sampling on the E026 tip.

structured_output.summary: The tip is E026 at 0.7565 / 5.50 s (compiled batched Muon, 2@16 + 2@24 + 4@32 px), with 0.35 pp of margin. Exploit ideas: cheapen the early phase further (3@16 + 1@24 + 4@32, priority 4), tune Muon momentum downward to 0.5, the direction away from E027's failure at 0.85 (priority 4), trim the remaining ~0.4 s of Muon overhead with 2 Newton-Schulz steps (priority 3), and calibrate the margin with an extra-seeds check on the current tip (priority 3). Explore ideas: the aggressive 4@16 + 4@32 schedule, a lower Muon lr (0.18), and per-phase power sampling to see whether the 16 px phase is overhead-bound. I032 and I033 are dropped because their base is stale; both are re-proposed on E026.
